verdict_reason: AnimalIdentifier omits 2 of the 5 AC-required per-unit fields (identification details, description), leaving part of the acceptance criteria untestable.

todos.issue: AnimalIdentifier only adds tattoo/horseName/permanentAddress of the 5 per-unit fields the AC requires (tattoo, horse name, identification details, description, permanent address) — animalIdentifierIdentificationDetails and animalIdentifierDescription have no slot, so tests can never assert either reaches the aggregate.
todos.fix: Add identificationDetails and description (or the equivalent wire names used by the frontend/backend PRs for this ticket) to AnimalIdentifier so the AC's full per-unit field set is representable.
